title: Charge Schedule — The Arrangement Charge on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Charge Schedule — The Arrangement Charge on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The charge the finance desk makes for putting an arrangement in place on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is read from what stands on the plan.

| The plan at the handling date | The arrangement charge |
|---|---|
| An arrangement already stands in force on it | This desk's repeat-arrangement charge of **5.00 USD** |
| No arrangement stands in force, **and** a payment on the plan has been sent back unpaid in the whole month ending on the handling date | This desk's arrangement charge of **2.50 USD** |
| Any other case | This desk's standard arrangement charge of **7.50 USD** |

The charge is the same figure on every promotional term; it is the plan's own circumstances, and not the term it was written on, that decide which of the three applies. A plan already running on an arrangement takes the repeat-arrangement charge whether or not a payment came back in the month just ending.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

| What the records show | The arrangement charge |
|---|---|
| The plan is already running on an arrangement, and a payment came back unpaid last month | 5.00 USD |
| No arrangement in force, a payment came back unpaid last month | 2.50 USD |
| No arrangement in force, no payment came back unpaid last month | 7.50 USD |
